props.gloss_en: the mishna: a sciatic nerve cooked with the sinews, if not recognised -- all of them are forbidden
the mishna: likewise a piece of a carcass [or of non-kosher fish] cooked with the pieces, if not recognised -- all of them are forbidden
a [distinct] entity is different -- [so the sciatic nerve is not nullified]
we learned: ANY [item] whose manner is to be counted
we learned: THAT [item] whose manner is to be counted
a piece is different, since it is fit to give honour with it before guests
had it taught us [only] the nerve -- [one would say] because it is a beriya; but a piece, say not
and had it taught us [only] the piece -- because it is fit to give honour with it before guests; but the nerve, say not. [Both are] necessary
a piece of carcass and of non-kosher fish does not forbid until it imparts flavour to the broth, the deposits and the pieces
once it imparted flavour to a piece, the piece itself becomes nevela
and it forbids all the pieces, every one
Rav Safra: now, in accordance with whom did Rav say his teaching? -- R' Yehuda
R' Yehuda, who says: a type with its own type is not nullified
Abaye: here we are dealing with where he first removed it
Rava: you may even say he did not first remove it -- it is a type, its type, and something else
and in every [case of] a type, its type and something else -- set aside its type as though it is not
and what is not its type is greater than it and nullifies it

supports.gloss_en: מפני שהן מינה -- the nevela-piece forbids all the pieces because they are of its type

objections.gloss_en: ותבטיל ברובא! -- let the unrecognised piece be nullified by the majority. הניחא למאן דאמר כל שדרכו לימנות שנינו, אלא למאן דאמר את שדרכו לימנות שנינו, מאי איכא למימר? (100a.3) -- the challenge stands only on the את-שדרכו view

answered_by.gloss_en: שאני חתיכה, הואיל וראויה להתכבד בה לפני האורחים (= p_chaticha_reuya_lehitkabed)

objections.gloss_en: מכדי רב כרבי יהודה אמרה, דאמר מין במינו לא בטיל -- מאי איריא כי נתן טעם? אפילו כי לא נתן טעם נמי! -- if a type with its type is not nullified, the piece should forbid all even without imparting flavour

answered_by.gloss_en: הכא במאי עסקינן -- בשקדם וסלקו (= p_abaye_kadam_vesilko)
אפילו תימא לא קדם וסלקו, הוי מין ומינו ודבר אחר; וכל מין ומינו ודבר אחר -- סלק את מינו כמי שאינו, ושאין מינו רבה עליו ומבטלו (= p_rava_min_umino_vedavar_acher)
